claims.text: The dataset used in the paper consists of tweets categorized into harassment and non-harassment, with sub-categories of indirect harassment, sexual harassment, and physical harassment.
The dataset is divided into a training set, validation set, and test set, and it is noted to be imbalanced, particularly in the indirect and physical harassment categories.
Data augmentation techniques were applied to address the imbalance in the dataset, specifically through back-translation methods.
